front.title: PCEP Extensions for PCE Central Controller (PCECC) based Network Resource Partition (NRP) Instantiation

abstract.t:
The PCE is a core component of Software-Defined Networking (SDN) systems. A PCE-based Central Controller (PCECC) can simplify the processing of a distributed control plane by blending it with elements of SDN without necessarily completely replacing it.
Network Resource Partitions (NRPs) can be used to provide the required connectivity and commited resources for network slice services. An NRP is a subset of the buffer/queuing/ scheduling resources and associated policies on each of a connected set of links in the underlay network.
This document specifies the extensions to Path Computation Element Communication Protocol (PCEP) to enable PCECC based Network Resource Partition (NRP) Instantiation.
